title: Stop Your AI Agents from Going Rogue with Agent Governance Toolkit
description:
Agent Governance Toolkit is a free, open-source tool from Microsoft that enforces policies on your AI agents. Define rules in YAML, block dangerous actions, track identity, and audit everything. Install with pip and wrap any tool with one line of code. Perfect for teams deploying autonomous agents in production.
